title: CEL Evaluation Test Suite
description: Schema for the -tests (-test_cases) input to `cel-expr eval`. Must be a top-level JSON array of test case objects (not wrapped in an outer object).

testCase.description: The descriptive name of the test case.

bindings.description: The variable bindings for the expression matching the `inputSchema` from `cel-expr eval`. May be omitted or empty when the expression does not reference any variables.

expected.description: The expected JSON output value of the expression matching the `outputSchema` from `cel-expr eval`.

Bindings.description: Map of variable names (as declared in the CEL environment) to their runtime JSON values. Also used as the schema for the single-case `-bindings` flag in `cel-expr eval`.
